preregistration.smoke_runs_before_prereg: disclosed in the pre-registration; raw/smoke/, never pooled

harness.name: gnomon
harness.install: release installer + release tarballs, SHA256SUMS verified

harness_config_hash.note: live surface hashes include the fake model's ephemeral URL (gap REP-6); arm definitions in PRE-REGISTRATION.md and set_toml() calls in overhead.py
harness_config_hash.env: HOME per arm under scratch, GNOMON_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1, GNOMON_BIN_OVERRIDE=<release natives>

models: n/a: scripted fake model (overhead.py Handler), OpenAI chat completions, streamed (gnomon default stream=true) and one-body (N, F0); no inference

hardware.core_layout: heterogeneous: 10 x Cortex-X925 (max 3900 MHz) + 10 x Cortex-A725 (max 2808 MHz); lscpu -e in cpu_table
hardware.machine: gx10 (NVIDIA GB10, shared: other benchmarks were running on it during these runs; load is recorded per measurement)
hardware.hardware_class: n/a: no GBS spec run here defines hardware classes (only GBS-HYBRID does)

apparatus.runner_commit: 7d8f9af7 (runner), b7a7c8df (gc.auto=0 fix for S3), run_all.sh / run_s3_rerun.sh orchestration
apparatus.task_set: S0, S1 (scripted, in overhead.py SCEN); S3 generator seed 20261104; S2 not run

n.main: S0,S1 x d{0,250} x 5 arms x 20 rounds = 400
n.strace_pass: 2 scenarios x 4 arms x 3 (spawn counts only)
n.aborted_and_rerun: 8 s3-d250 trials on a partial copy, raw/aborted/, excluded (deviation)

validity.mapping: pass = valid trial per §6 (exit 0, full scripted sequence with expected tool results, final hash); fail/timeout n/a for a timing spec

mde: n/a (no hypothesis test). Pre-stated resolution: about ±7 ms on a paired CPU difference at 20 rounds if the paired SD is ≤ 15 ms; observed CI half-widths are below that

primary.method: median of per-round paired differences, 95% percentile bootstrap over 20 rounds (10,000 resamples, seed 1)

reliability: n/a: a timing spec with a deterministic script; every valid trial completes by construction

cost.note: no model; bytes per request from the fake model's log are in analysis.json

telemetry: CPU: getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) under a child subreaper; wall/first-request: one CLOCK_MONOTONIC (runner and fake model share a process); RSS: wait4 ru_maxrss; spawns: strace execve (separate pass); fidelity: gnomon's own task JSON (harness self-report, the only source the spec allows for 'what the harness recorded')

latency.note: medians and IQR per cell in analysis.json; capped 0

incidents: S3 20k: git auto-gc detached by the fixture commit raced the arm copy; block crashed, s3-d250 started on a partial copy and was stopped after 8 trials (kept in raw/aborted/, excluded); fixed with gc.auto=0 and re-run (deviations log)
deviations: PRE-REGISTRATION.md deviations log: 2 entries (S3 re-run, before reading S3 outcomes; fidelity analysis note, after)

traces.chain_heads: n/a: gnomon's audit trails are removed between trials by design (each cold-process trial is a first session)

scope: system: gnomon v0.4.1 + default/ablated surfaces + scripted model + linux/aarch64 (X925-pinned). No other harness measured
authorship: author-run; gnomon's authors wrote OVERHEAD.md and this apparatus. Run by Claude Code (Opus 5.5) for the gnomon project

C1_C2_startup_and_prompt_build.method: inferred: time to first model request, gnomon minus N (wall, not CPU)

C3_policy.method: in-process timing of decide() x the S1 calls (3 edit, 2 bash, 5 read/grep at the read cost) — not one of the spec's three methods (OVH-3)

C4_records.method: ablation (default − audit-off, paired); in-process tool_call record 0.0164 ms

C5_tool_exec.method: inferred: 2 tool spawns (sh -c true, 0.59 ms CPU each) in both gnomon and N; net ≈ 0. gnomon's grep is in-process, N's spawns grep

C6_workspace.method: inferred: 4 git spawns per S1 trial (strace) x 1.3–1.8 ms each at 0 files; grows with repository size (S3: added CPU over N 125 ms at 0 files, 563 at 20,000, 995 at 50,000)

components_S1_d0_default.C8_unattributed: the remainder: about 50 ms of the 126 ms added (≈40%), mixing a wall-time C1+C2 with CPU figures; read as an order of magnitude
components_S1_d0_default.M_note: one edit call: decide() (decision ask:approval) + one chained tool_call record write, in-process, X925 core. Approval resolution itself is not included. Not comparable to Auditable Agents' 8.3 ms until both state their conditions (§2)
